# CPDataKit v0.7.0

The local workbench now supports the full upload, schema selection, validation, conversion and
report workflow for tabular and multidimensional data.

- Application services read NetCDF, Zarr 3, Parquet and HDF5 2.0 through the format adapters.
  Schema 2.0 validation checks dimensions, fields, types, units and missing or non-finite values.
- HDF5 conversion uses layout 1.0 for tabular data and layout 2.0 for scientific arrays. Callers
  can also select NetCDF, Zarr or tabular Parquet output.
- Project pages provide custom schema upload, Zarr directory upload, validation findings,
  conversion and report jobs, cancellation, HTML report previews and result downloads.
- Completed jobs remain available after a server restart. Interrupted jobs are reported as failed.
  Failed uploads can be corrected and retried with the same filename.

Python >=3.12, runtime dependencies and the v0.5 public API, CLI, schema 1.0 and HDF5 1.0 contracts
remain unchanged.

```shell
python -m pip install --upgrade cpdatakit==0.7.0
cpdatakit ui
```

See the [workbench guide](https://github.com/17636365690/cpdatakit/blob/v0.7.0/docs/v0.7-workbench.md)
for supported formats and examples.
